en: Launch your whole weight forward and land hard, stunning rivals within {r}m for {secs}s.
Dive forward in a lunge and rob {n} food from every rival you touch.
Spawns a decoy copy beside you for {secs}s to soak up rival attacks.
Kicks dust backwards: chasers within {r}m slow to {pct}% speed for {secs}s.
Hide in an egg for {secs} seconds. You can't move, but nobody can push you, stop you or steal your food.
For {secs}s, rivals within {r}m of you move at {pct}% speed.
Leave a slow patch ({r}m) for {secs}s. Rivals inside move at {pct}% speed.
Slow every rival within {r}m to {pct}% speed for {secs}s.
Throws a feather cloud ahead that lasts {secs}s - chickens in it slow to {pct}% speed.
A hard sidestep. Walls still stop you.
A stomp that leaves everyone within {r}m stuck in place for {secs}s.
Shoves rivals up to {r}m ahead and staggers them for {secs}s.
Plant yourself for {secs}s. You can't be stunned, slowed, stuck or shoved.
Turn almost invisible for {secs}s. Using a move ends it.
Picks a rival to hunt for {window}s. In the last {live}s, if they are stunned and within {r}m, press again to pounce and take all their food.
Take a beakful of food from the pile you are standing at.
Banks food {mult}x faster for {secs}s - cash in at your base.
Rolls forward at {mult}x speed for {secs}s, shoving chickens out of the path.
Drops a sticky egg. The first chicken to step on it is stuck for {secs}s.
A burst of pace: {mult}x speed for {secs}s. Enough to close a gap or leave one.
Grabs {n} food off the nearest rival within {r}m.
Drops a choking cloud ({r}m, {secs}s): you fade, rivals inside slow to {pct}% speed. Using a move breaks it.
Take {n} food from every rival within {r}m.
Yanks {n} food from the nearest rival within {r}m. Same bird: every {secs}s.
For {secs}s, any rival who bumps into you loses {n} food to you and gets knocked away.
Walk slowly for {walk}s (slows can't stop you), then turn into an egg for {egg}s: nothing can touch you. Press again to come out early.
Your stuns and slows last {out}% longer.
Your stuns and slows last {out}% longer. Stuns, getting stuck and timed slows on you end {in}% sooner.
Applies to every move except Peck.
Rob the bird with your loot bag for {bounty} extra food. {prize} extra food if time runs out. Carry {cap} food.

One rival carries your loot bag, and only you and that bird can see it. Rob that bird: you grab the food it holds, and {bounty} new food drops into your beak, as far as it fits. A new bag shows up just before your Steal is ready again. If time runs out before anyone reaches {goal}, you get {prize} extra food at home. You carry up to {cap} food.
Ability slows on you are {pct}% weaker and end {pct}% sooner.
Stuns still land in full. Pile and bump slows still apply.
Knockback cut by {kb}%. Stuns, getting stuck and timed slows end {cc}% sooner.
Bank {pct}% faster. Piles and bumps never slow you.
You bank food {pct}% faster, and food piles and bumping into rivals never slow you down.
Your Hunt goes after the bird with the most food {x} times more often. Carry {cap} food.
The bird with the most food at home is {x} times as likely to be hunted. A kill fills your beak with food: you carry up to {cap} food.
Tap a move for the details.
